Hi Mum, Kirsty and Linda,

I’ve got a wee surprise planned for Gran’s 80th! Morag’s letting me have Hair by Morag to myself on Saturday 12 December from 1pm, so I can do everyone’s hair before we head out for dinner. Gran’s not in on this, obviously—keep it quiet!

We’ve got dinner booked for 8.30pm at the Italian on Byres Road, with Uncle Davie and Kirsty’s man joining us there. There are seven of us for hair: me, Mum, Kirsty, Linda, Gran, Ava and Ruby. A cut and blow-dry for everyone is no bother. Ava and Ruby can have wee braids and glitter spray too—they’ll love that.

If you’d like colour as well, let me know what you’re after by Friday 27 November so I can order everything from the wholesaler. Gran mentioned at Easter she’d love to go properly silver, so I could look into that for her—but please don’t tell her! And Linda, we’ll make sure the cooker and dog stay dye-free this time 😄

Mum, could you get Gran to the salon for 1 without giving the game away? You’re probably our best bet. Morag closes at 12, so we’ll have the place from 1 and plenty of time to get everyone ready.

Bring a bottle of fizz if you fancy; Morag’s happy for us to have some as long as we tidy up afterwards. Can you all get back to me with what you’d like done—and any colours—by the 27th? Can’t wait to get us all glammed up for Gran!

Love,
[Your name]
